question: Should OpenClaw publish `PluginInteractiveHandlerResult.submitText` as a supported channel-neutral plugin-SDK contract, with Discord as the newly supported transport alongside Telegram?
rationale: The patch is mechanically bounded and proof-positive, but public SDK contract scope and compatibility are maintainer product/API decisions rather than a defect that automated review can resolve.

options.title: Approve the shared contract
options.body: Accept `submitText` as a documented channel-neutral result, merge this Discord implementation, and let unsupported channels continue to ignore it.

options.title: Keep it transport-specific
options.body: Retain the existing Telegram-only contract and decline or redesign the Discord addition until a narrower channel API is approved.

options.title: Define a broader interaction API first
options.body: Pause this PR while maintainers specify lifecycle, support guarantees, and semantics for cross-channel plugin interaction results.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared contract
recommendation.body: Accept `submitText` as a documented channel-neutral result, merge this Discord implementation, and let unsupported channels continue to ignore it.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current implementation and can address a concrete contract decision or follow-up requested by the plugin-SDK owner.
